text:
rachel: quick Q  Diego is on J-1 with 212(e). counsel says waiver likely needed before US payroll. what does that mean for the relocation stipend & signing bonus timing?
diego: hi! hopeful to start 2026-06-15 onsite but can remote-start. id love the relocation stipend earlier to secure housing. any way to get an advance?
sarah: legal note: if Diego will be physically outside US, paying him as a contractor may be possible but check local labor/tax rules. If he's outside and we make a payroll payment from US, payroll/tax gets complex. Waiver timelines vary (8-24 weeks in some cases).
rachel: policy summary: relocation/signing payments are normally processed via payroll after employee record created. we can consider a relocation advance (taxable) as a one-time exception; requires finance approval and a signed advance agreement.
paul: team can accept remote-only ramp for 6-10 weeks. no production access until payroll + BG. can he do onboarding pair-programming?
rachel: yes, meetings and read-only repos OK. no deploy keys or prod creds.
finance-bot: FYI: relocation advance rules:
- advances processed on payroll vendor as a taxable draw; requires signed Advance Agreement (A-Form)
- withholding applies per US payroll rules even if employee is abroad
- if paid before payroll setup, we can route as vendor reimbursement but need contractor paperwork + W-8/W-9 as applicable
- finance approval required (Escalate to compops@)
diego: so if im abroad and receive an advance, i'll be taxed per US rules? that could leave me short.
finance-bot: correct. US payroll will withhold based on US rates. If Diego is tax resident elsewhere, he may need to file for refund in his home country later. We can model net-vs-gross advance amounts; finance can propose a net-advance option (gross-up) subject to approval.
sarah: legal action items:
- Diego: upload DS-2019 and passport page to secure portal
- Counsel: confirm whether waiver intake submitted and estimate timeline in 5bd
rachel: people-ops action items:
- Draft relocation-advance A-Form and route to finance for net/gross options
- Create "remote-limited" onboarding checklist and restrict prod access until payroll clears
- Note on equity: equity cliff & vesting anchor to payroll hire date by default; comp can review exceptions but it's rare
paul: confirmed team OK with delayed onsite and remote ramp. please keep me cc'd.
diego: uploading docs now. thank you all for flexibility :pray:
finance-bot: recorded provisional state = "pending_work_auth". no payroll actions until I-9 completes.
